docs.title: Notice of public hearing: Juniper Creek trail extension, phase 2
lines: The City Council will hold a public hearing on October 13 at 6 pm on the proposed trail extension and its use of parkland.

docs.title: Notice of public hearing: zoning change at Ridge Road and FM 1960
lines: The Planning and Zoning Commission will hear a request to rezone 14 acres from agricultural to mixed residential.

docs.title: Invitation to bid: Main Street repaving, 1st to 9th Street
lines: Sealed bids are due by 2 pm on October 8 to the Purchasing office. Plans and specifications are available online.

docs.title: Request for proposals: website accessibility audit
lines: The city seeks proposals for a WCAG 2.1 AA audit of its website, documents and online forms.

lines: Caption of an ordinance adopting fees for city services for fiscal 2027, set for second reading on October 13.

docs.title: Notice of general and special election, November 3, 2026
lines: A special election on Proposition A, a $48 million bond for streets and drainage, will be held with the general election.

docs.title: Lane closures: Falls Parkway at Mill Street, October 12 to 23
lines: One westbound lane will be closed overnight from 8 pm to 5 am for signal upgrades.
